style: Style: Japanese shin-hanga woodblock print in the spirit of Kawase Hasui and Hokusai, fine black ink outlines, rich detail, soft bokashi color gradation, subtle washi paper grain, natural colors of indigo, teal, pine green, sand and rust. A large landscape painting, not an icon or sticker. Absolutely no text, no letters, no kanji, no numbers, no logos, no signature, no seal stamp, no border, no frame. No people. Fill the whole square edge to edge.

art.umi/inside: A wide panorama of the Uradome coast on the Sea of Japan in Tottori. The middle of the picture is calm deep blue-green sea. Top: a white granite cliff with windswept black pines. Right: a tall white granite rock islet with one pine on its top and small rocks around it. Left: a long rocky headland and distant blue mountains, with a few sea birds. Bottom: a pale sand beach with gentle white waves and two small pines.
art.umi/cover: Close view of a white granite rock arch standing in the Sea of Japan with a single windswept pine tree on its very top, clear turquoise water showing through the arch, small rocks, white foam, a soft sky with a few clouds.
art.kani/inside: A winter panorama of a small Japanese fishing harbor on the Sea of Japan at dusk, Tottori. The middle of the picture is dark indigo water with soft snow falling. Top: snowy low mountains under a dusky sky. Right: small wooden crab fishing boats with bright lamps moored at a stone pier. Left: a row of old fishing houses with snow on dark roofs, warm lit windows. Bottom: a stone quay with wooden crates and coiled rope, snow on the ground. Small details only, no people.
art.kani/cover: One big male snow crab with long jointed legs seen from above, painted in fine woodblock detail, resting on dark indigo winter sea with stylized waves in the manner of Hokusai, gentle snow falling.
art.eki/inside: An autumn panorama of a quiet country town in Tottori, Japan. Important: the four corners of the image will be cut off, so everything important must stay well inside a diamond shape, close to the center. The very middle of the picture is a soft rice field and gentle mist. Top center: green and rust colored mountains. Middle right, not touching the right edge: a small old one-storey railway station with a red tiled roof and white wooden columns, drawn small and complete, a short single track in front, no signs, no company marks. Middle left, not touching the left edge: a small old hot spring village with wooden inns and soft white steam rising among trees. Bottom center, directly below the middle of the picture: one very large elongated orange pumpkin resting on grass, complete and not cut off, with a stone path around it.
art.eki/cover: A small old one-storey Japanese country railway station with a red tiled roof and white wooden columns, seen from the front, a very large elongated orange pumpkin beside the entrance, green mountains behind in autumn, soft evening light. No signs, no company marks.
